query.selection: Same REG/live pass-run and kneel/spike/two-point exclusions as schematic_context_audit. Designed runs exclude scrambles; scramble means qb_scramble=true, rush_attempt=true and observed dropback. Retain all runner positions and touchdowns/fumbles; do not infer the original RPO call.
query.outcomes: Require penalty=false and finite yards_gained. Live flagged/missing-flag runs are counted separately. This is an explicit penalty-flag filter, not reconstructed acceptance/enforcement.
query.gains: Whole-play yards_gained, not individual rushing_yards. Report interpolated p10/p25/p50/p75/p90/p95/p99, mean/max, disjoint bins below0/zero/positiveUnder4/4toUnder7/7toUnder10/10toUnder20/20plus, negative<0, stuff<=0,10plus,20plus.
query.success: Known positive ydstogo and down1-4: gain>=40% on first,60% on second,100% on third/fourth. Separately report gain>=ydstogo, recorded first_down_rush or rush_touchdown, and positive model-derived EPA. Turnovers retain their gain but have separate recorded fumble_lost and distance-gain-without-turnover counts.
query.explosiveGeometry: 10+/20+ all-run rates plus eligible-field rates where yardline_100>=10/>=20 respectively. Excludes no touchdowns; geometry-conditioned rates are still selected mixtures, not NFL targets.
query.carrier: Exact season+rusher_player_id match to season roster gsis_id; QB, RB/FB, other or unknown. Roster position is not snap role. Conflicting listed positions for an identity remain ambiguous/unknown rather than guessed.
query.context: Reuse schematic pilot down,distance1to3/4to7/8to10/11to19/20plus, field0to20/21to50/51to100, scoretrailing9plus/within8/leading9plus, regulation-last600s vs earlier/overtime/unknown. Retain all thin cells and actual n.
query.chart2022: Exact FTN game/play join. Separate known boolean QB sneak,motion,RPO strata and known integer0-11 n_defense_box strata<=5/6/7/8plus. Box count is charted presentation, never a called Over/Under/Odd/Tite/Bear front. Missing2023 charting is unavailable, not false/zero.
query.witnesses: Third and20plus; exact third-and27; ordinary RB/FB designed runs on down1/2,distance8to10,outside redzone,within8,earlier regulation. Declared before outcomes; witnesses never imply identified concepts/fronts.
query.variation: Describe 64 team-season designed-run distributions and their metric percentiles. Observed roster/opponent/game-script mixture, not confidence intervals, independent trials or generated-roster limits.
query.limitations: PBP has no blocking concept, all-22 front, contact force, tackle control or yards-before-contact field. Run_location/run_gap describe observed direction/location, not blocking scheme. No causal score/box effects, significance test or physical calibration.
